newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 4.36 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 4.36 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 4,358,400 lbs of frozen beef products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal programs.
Details of the purchase are as follows:
Total purchases since the program was announced May 17:
The latest award under Announcement LS-48, Invitation 026, will be shipped between January 6 and 31, 1997.
Winning bidders for the reprocessing beef were Aksarben Foods Inc (Omaha NE) 1,638,000 lbs, Robzens Inc (Scranton PA) 84,000 lbs and Service Packing Co (Joplin MO) 1,386,000 lbs.
Winning bidders for beef special trim were Federal Beef Processors (Rapid City SD) 588,000 lbs, Fresno Meat Co (Fresno CA) 420,000 lbs and Star Ranch (Marshalltown IA) 84,000 lbs.
The winning bidder for 1-Pound Chubs were Supreme Beef Processors (Dallas TX).
